dict.string: With normal iOS 16 notification behaviour, apps such as Snapchat can vibrate for the first notification, while notifications that arrive straight after it may be delivered without another vibration. EveryNotifyVibe fixes this by forcing every enabled app notification to vibrate, including repeated and grouped notifications, so every notification gets a vibration.
All apps are enabled by default. Open Applications to turn EveryNotifyVibe on or off for individual apps, or use Enable All / Disable All. Changes apply immediately.

Master Enabled off: EveryNotifyVibe stops adding forced vibrations everywhere. Turning off an individual app only disables the tweak for that app; its normal iOS vibration behaviour remains unchanged.
